original_test_intent: Measure PCIe bandwidth across the approved HGX host/root-port/switch/GPU path with NVQual Test #3 and prove each required direction and workload meets the project throughput threshold while link state, device inventory, host, and GPUs remain stable without hang or unplanned reboot.
original_method: Pin the Test #3 recipe, endpoints/path, transfer direction, memory domains, payload/buffer/concurrency, warmup, sample duration and repetitions, generation/width, raw byte/time measurement, aggregation and threshold/tolerance; preserve baselines; record raw per-sample throughput with synchronized link/device/error/thermal/power state; abort on first performance or health fault and recover out of band.
manual_activity: HGX owner/FAE approves the proprietary Test #3 recipe, topology, performance threshold and any reset/power behavior; an operator isolates the SUT, supervises recovery, and reviews workload placement and thermal/power margin.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #3 bandwidth package/configuration and compatible firmware/driver
Exact host/root-port/switch/retimer/GPU, NUMA and memory-domain topology
Direction matrix, payload/buffer size, concurrency, warmup, sampling duration, repetitions, link generation/width, and competing-load policy
Raw byte/time calculation, units, aggregation, threshold/tolerance, iterations, control actions, aborts, recovery, and final-state rules
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production HGX SUT with explicit bandwidth-load and any reset/power authorization
No unsaved workload; verified BMC/console/power recovery and stable cooling/power capacity
Preserve raw baselines/logs and validate topology, NUMA placement, device identity, and available storage before load
Stop on below-limit performance with health anomaly, link downgrade, missing GPU, new AER, hang/reboot, thermal/power limit, tool fault, or evidence gap
No load extension, hidden retries, evidence clearing, or unapproved reset/power cycle
agent_execution_scope: Validate Test #3 recipe, target path, workload, measurement formula, baseline, collectors, and interlocks
Run only approved directions, samples, repetitions, duration, and control boundaries
Retain raw bytes, timing and sample results before computing aggregates
Correlate throughput with link, NUMA/CPU placement, GPU/device identity, errors, thermal, power, OS, and BMC health
Do not infer performance limits, substitute link width for throughput, retry faults, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Test #3 recipe, topology, direction/memory/workload matrix, sampling plan, and any reset/power scope
Define raw measurement, aggregation, units, threshold/tolerance, link and system acceptance
Review raw samples/calculations/stability evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It identifies the qualification family but only verifies link/device state. Without raw transferred bytes, timed interval, direction/workload and project threshold it cannot establish bandwidth.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the pinned Test #3 manifest and retain immutable raw bytes and high-resolution timing per direction/sample, with configuration, topology/NUMA placement, link state, device identity and health evidence sufficient to independently recalculate throughput.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #3, PCIe bandwidth, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/15-minute estimates remain; missing workload and limit values are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL REPRODUCIBLE HGX PCIE BANDWIDTH QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Measure each approved transfer direction using pinned buffers/concurrency and topology, retain raw byte/time samples, report distribution and project-approved aggregation, and bind any shortfall to link/NUMA/device/thermal/power evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds quantitative measurement, direction and memory-domain coverage, repeatability, raw evidence, threshold comparison, stability interlocks, and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Negotiated link generation/width is theoretical capacity and cannot prove application-level or DMA bandwidth, direction symmetry, sustained performance, or absence of throttling.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Workload placement, NUMA, cache effects, warmup, power and thermal state materially affect results; reset/power actions can also break device availability and measurement continuity.

project_override_considerations: Vendor aggregate PASS may be retained only when the pinned artifact exposes the direction matrix, workload, raw samples or auditable calculation, threshold, and topology. A theoretical PCIe encoding calculation is context, not observed bandwidth evidence.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #3 manifest, authorization, and configuration hash
Raw per-sample bytes/timestamps/durations, recalculated throughput, distribution/aggregate, and threshold comparison
First-fault recovery or clean final device/link/host state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Test #3 Procedure identify PCIe bandwidth while Criteria provides only generic suite/stability acceptance. The absence of the quantitative workload and threshold is under-specification rather than a contradictory target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Bandwidth measurement intent is clear. Proprietary tooling, topology, workload, measurement/threshold contract, isolated hardware, and recovery are identifiable execution prerequisites, not permanent review blockers.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2126 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00003-V002: approve the exact NVQual Test #3 bandwidth package/configuration, host/root-port/switch/retimer/GPU/NUMA map, transfer-direction and memory-domain matrix, payload/buffer/concurrency/warmup/sample duration/repetitions, raw byte/time formula and units, aggregation, expected threshold/tolerance, iterations, any reset/power boundary, aborts, and out-of-band recovery.

review_improvement: Makes PCIe bandwidth reproducible from raw samples and topology rather than treating negotiated link status as performance, while retaining the suite's no-hang/no-reboot stability requirements.
independent_technical_reasoning: Negotiated PCIe generation and width establish only an upper-bound transport capability. Observed bandwidth depends on direction, DMA path, memory domain, NUMA placement, transfer size, concurrency, warmup and timing methodology. Therefore the raw byte and time inputs must survive independently of NVQual's aggregate, and performance must be correlated with link and thermal/power state. A rerun after a transient shortfall can hide the causal condition, so the first failing sample and health timeline are preserved before any recovery.
